Whoever wants his provision expanded and his life lengthened should keep good relations with his relatives.
When creation was done the womb sought refuge from those who sever ties, and Allah promised to favour whoever keeps them and withhold from whoever severs them.
Keeping ties of kinship leads to Paradise, more wealth and longer life, and severing them bars Paradise; the womb sought Allah's refuge, and the true keeper restores ties others cut.
When creation was finished, the womb sought Allah's refuge from those who sever it, and He promised to join whoever joins it and cut whoever cuts it.
